Hi Tom —

Following up on invoices 2028-02-17 and 2028-02-28 (attached). Our finance team shows these as due and we'd like to confirm your planned funding window so we can schedule remittance and avoid a service pause. Quick asks: 

- Can you confirm whether HelixWorks will pay both invoices in one transfer or split across two transactions? If split, please indicate which invoice maps to which payment reference.
- Which payment rail will you use: ACH (preferred), wire, or card? If wire, please confirm expected send date and provide the wire trace once sent.
- We still need an up-to-date W-9 on file for HelixWorks (we do not have one in your vendor record). If you can attach that to your reply, it will speed reconciliation.

If helpful, our preferred remittance email is ap@redwood.com and we can accept either ACH (ACH routing/Acct on request) or Fedwire. I can send the Fedwire instructions by reply if you prefer wire.

We appreciate any timing you can share — our collections cutoff for this billing cycle is 17 Mar 2028 23:59 PT; if funds are initiated by then we can apply them to March invoices.

Thanks,
Irene

Hi Tom — thanks for the quick reply and the remittance stub. Clarifications below: 

- Combined payment is fine. Please use payment reference HW-INV-03 and include both invoice numbers in the description so our AP can auto-apply.
- Wire is okay — please route to the Fedwire instructions attached to this thread (also available here: https://redwood.app/docs/wire-instructions).
- We actually need Redwood's W-9 uploaded to your vendor record to satisfy your procurement team (occasionally procurement requests the vendor-form W-9 for tax reporting). I have attached a current copy (W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf) for you to drop into HelixWorks vendor portal.

One operational note: if the wire is initiated on 2028-03-13 before 16:00 ET and you include the trace, our treasury team will reconcile and mark the invoices as paid same-day. If the wire posts after our 23:59 PT cutoff we'll still receive it but it may not reflect on the March remittance batch for your billing cycle.

Please reply with the wire trace when available and confirm once the W-9 is uploaded so I can close the collection task on our side.

Thanks,
Irene
